accepted.evidence: Turner 7712 explicitly lists Pashai paṛ- 'reads' immediately after Prakrit paḍhaï; Lehr's Darrai paṛ- 'read' is an exact lexical and semantic match. The causative 'teach' forms in the same article are distinct and are not assigned here.

held.reason: Turner 3241 groups Paš. kuṭ- under kuṭṭáyati but also has a separate *kōṭṭayati branch; Darrai o does not yet select between them.
Turner 5745 gives Paš. testewā́ 'standing' with restoration of s; the relation of Lehr's finite/infinitive stem to that participial form needs morphology review.
